description: Land Acquisition - Siyambalawehera, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (lots 222-343) with descriptions of each property, including land names, types (garden, paddy field, road, canal), claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and it doesn't fit any other specialized categories.
